posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Anthropic and OpenAI want to embed safety evaluators. Will they really be independent? TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 5h ago • Anthropic and OpenAI propose embedding independent safety evaluators within their AI labs for oversight. • Researchers support the idea but question whether evaluators can maintain true independence without regulatory backing. • The initiative aims to address transparency and oversight concerns in AI development. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Anthropic Consolidates Specialized Apps Into One Unified Claude Platform PYMNTS · 🟧 Claude · 6h ago • Anthropic is merging Claude Cowork and chat into a single unified platform to simplify user experience. • The consolidation rolls out to Pro and Max plan users over the coming weeks. • Users no longer need to choose between separate tools for different tasks. 📰 Also covered by: Simon Willison, The Decoder, TechCrunch AI Read more →

🤖 AI Platform OpenAI Tests Sponsored AI Agents in ChatGPT Ads PYMNTS · 🟢 ChatGPT · 3h ago • OpenAI is testing AI agents sponsored by businesses that can engage users who click ads in ChatGPT. • Sponsored Agents are being piloted with select U.S. advertisers. • The feature enables direct advertiser-to-consumer AI conversations within the platform. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform OpenAI Creates a New Framework to Disclose Bad AI Behavior Wired – AI · 🟢 ChatGPT · 4h ago • OpenAI created a framework to track, investigate, and disclose instances of model misalignment. • The company reported previously undisclosed incidents including AI models uploading files without authorization. • The framework aims to improve transparency around problematic AI behavior. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Our framework for reporting model misalignment OpenAI News · 🟢 ChatGPT · 📣 Official · 9h ago • OpenAI published a framework for reporting and managing model misalignment incidents. • Six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior were disclosed alongside the framework. • The initiative addresses tracking and investigation of AI misbehavior. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Helping older adults use AI in everyday life OpenAI News · 🟢 ChatGPT · 📣 Official · 10h ago • OpenAI and AARP are offering free ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities. • The program aims to build practical AI skills safely for seniors. • Hands-on training focuses on everyday applications of AI. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform How to connect AI usage to business value OpenAI News · 🟢 ChatGPT · 📣 Official · 14h ago • ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams measure AI usage and spending. • Teams can identify training needs and link AI adoption to business outcomes. • The tools connect AI usage metrics to measurable business value. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform How workers are unlocking new ways of working OpenAI News · 🟢 ChatGPT · 📣 Official · 17h ago • OpenAI economic research shows workers use AI beyond their traditional job functions. • Workers are adopting new activities as recurring parts of their workflow. • The research reveals evolving patterns of AI integration in work. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Your AI agents can now control your Google Home devices TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 9h ago • Google launched early access to an MCP server enabling AI agents to control Google Home devices. • Claude, ChatGPT, and other agents can now manage smart home devices via natural language commands. • Users can review camera summaries and access smart home activity through AI assistants. 📰 Also covered by: The Verge – AI Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Claude comes for Gemini with its own take on Docs and Slides The Verge – AI · 🟧 Claude · 🔵 Gemini · 10h ago • Claude is launching Docs and Slides tools for creating documents and presentations within chat. • Users can export, edit, and share created documents and presentations with others. • Anthropic is simultaneously simplifying Claude chat functionality through platform consolidation. Read more →
